## A5 での変更点

A4.1 から実装部品 5 点、新しい型番 1 種類を追加しました。

| 基板 | 参照 | JLC | 数/台 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---: |
| controller | U7 | C398363 | 1 |
| controller | R24 | C23138 | 1 |
| controller | R25 | C21190 | 1 |
| controller | C17 | C14663 | 1 |
| each\_led\_leaf | J2 | C160404 | 2 |

- **adc_formula**: VADC=(100/133)\*(VDD/2+CV/8); CV=10.64\*VADC-4\*VDD
- **input_filter_change**: C13 moved to CV\_AFFINE upstream of existing R7; stored charge reaches U7/D3 through R7. DC gain and fitted count unchanged; nominal pole approximately 776Hz.
- **harness_revision**: \{"controller": "J3 pins1GND/2VLED/3DATA\_L/4DATA\_R; J4 removed", "leaf": "J1 pins3/4=DATA\_THIS/DATA\_OTHER; J2 pins3/4=DATA\_OTHER/DATA\_THIS", "cables": "Two existing 1:1 harnesses: controller J3 -&gt; left J1; left J2 -&gt; right J1", "extra\_fitted\_header\_net": 1\}
- **removed_parts**: [\{"board": "controller", "ref": "J4", "c\_code": "C160404", "quantity\_per\_module": 1\}]

A4 / A4.1 の価格・数量・ADC 式は `history_A4/`・`history_A4_1/` に履歴として残っていますが、A5 の値を上書きしません。
